identity.name: Forgotten Runes Wizards Cult
identity.notes: Forgotten Runes Wizards Cult ships a per-token VRM file served from the project's own nftz subdomain. The VRM URL is resolved from the token metadata tokenURI plus a known template; structural validation of the sample URL confirms a valid GLB 2.0 file with the VRM 0.x extension. The catalog currently holds a single sample URL; expanding the template to enumerate every wizard requires validating all 9,944 templates, which is outside this incremental pass. The inventory is therefore recorded as a holder-gated, project-hosted VRM lane with the verified sample URL serving as the canonical reference.

source_evidence.note: Official Forgotten Runes site documents the nftz.forgottenrunes.com per-token VRM endpoint as the canonical wizard avatar file.
First 4 KiB and full JSON chunk confirmed as GLB 2.0 with VRM 0.x extension payload; total file length 3,588,560 bytes.

avatar_inventory.note: The catalog records the verified sample VRM as the canonical avatar asset. The full per-token enumeration is delegated to the existing template-driven probe path; the structural validation of the sample URL establishes the avatar-ready lane.

file_access.note: The Forgotten Runes VRM endpoint is publicly addressable by token ID; the holders' experience is gated by the holder-facing portal that exposes the link. The per-token URL is consistent with the public wizard download flow described on the official site.
